name: bq-property-tax
description: Review 2026 national property tax in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. Use for Caribbean Netherlands vastgoedbelasting, liability at year start, valuation decisions, independent dwellings, hotel conditions, investment relief, co-owners, time-share rights, island surcharges, notifications and objections. Distinguishes national tax from local grondbelasting and separates valuation challenges from assessment and collection. Supplies primary legislation and hypothetical component positions for professional review. This draft cites primary sources and retains unresolved principal rounding, local tax coverage, exemption prerequisites, forms and engagement procedures. It cannot produce a complete operational assessment package or establish comprehensive country coverage.
